actionLog: Implemented all three named filters in CommentsPanel.jsx's sidebar: date-range pills (24h/week/month/any time) on createdAt, a keyword search box (matches comment text + target label), and an 'Element' Ctrl/Cmd+click picker reusing DevOverlay.jsx's existing findTarget/labelForElement heuristic, filterable/clearable via a chip. Caught and fixed a real bug while verifying: the element-pick handler initially excluded .jynx-chrome (copying DevOverlay's hover-highlight restriction), which would have made it impossible to filter by clicking Jynx's own toolbar/settings elements even though many real comments in this queue target exactly those — removed that exclusion. Did not build the vague trailing '...and more.. take that logic make it perfect' beyond the three named filter types — nothing concrete to implement there. See PR #47.
